user.title: Connect to a LumenCache ReNetA system
user.description: Enter the broker details and the Prefix Topic that LumenCache gave you.

reconfigure.title: Change the connection
reconfigure.description: Change the broker details or the Prefix Topic of this system.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the host, port, username, password and Prefix Topic.

abort.already_configured: This system is already set up.

init.title: LumenCache options
init.description: The system cannot list its zones, so enter the ones you want as lights, for example `250: Living room, 251: Kitchen`.

error.invalid_range: The coolest value must be higher than the warmest.

set_light.name: Set light
set_light.description: Set a light or zone precisely, with brightness down to 0.1%. Zero turns it off.

send_raw.name: Send raw command
send_raw.description: Send any ReNetA command to the system. Use with care.

command.name: Command
command.description: The command as an object, for example {"e": 57, "g": 14, "bri": 50}.

system.name: System
system.description: Which system to send to. Not needed with only one.

no_devices.title: No LumenCache devices found
no_devices.description: The integration is connected to the broker but no device has been announced for 10 minutes. Check the Prefix Topic under Settings, Devices & services, LumenCache, Reconfigure, and that the system is online. Devices are announced when the system connects, so restarting it may help.
